findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aiapplyd_get_matches, aiapplyd_get_inbox, aiapplyd_reply_to_email, aiapplyd_generate_cover_letter, aiapplyd_manage_follow_ups, aiapplyd_manage_saved_searches · Private data: aiapplyd_review_application, aiapplyd_get_account, aiapplyd_set_resume, aiapplyd_get_inbox, aiapplyd_score_resume, aiapplyd_optimize_resume, aiapplyd_translate_resume, aiapplyd_generate_cover_letter, aiapplyd_build_pdf, aiapplyd_update_application_profile, aiapplyd_manage_follow_ups · Public sink: aiapplyd_set_resume, aiapplyd_get_inbox, aiapplyd_reply_to_email, aiapplyd_translate_resume, aiapplyd_build_pdf, aiapplyd_manage_follow_ups, aiapplyd_manage_saved_searches · Destructive: aiapplyd_update_job_preferences, aiapplyd_generate_cover_letter, aiapplyd_manage_saved_searches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aiapplyd_get_matches, aiapplyd_get_inbox, aiapplyd_reply_to_email, aiapplyd_generate_cover_letter, aiapplyd_manage_follow_ups, aiapplyd_manage_saved_searches · Private data: aiapplyd_review_application, aiapplyd_get_account, aiapplyd_set_resume, aiapplyd_get_inbox, aiapplyd_score_resume, aiapplyd_optimize_resume, aiapplyd_translate_resume, aiapplyd_generate_cover_letter, aiapplyd_build_pdf, aiapplyd_update_application_profile, aiapplyd_manage_follow_ups · Public sink: aiapplyd_set_resume, aiapplyd_get_inbox, aiapplyd_reply_to_email, aiapplyd_translate_resume, aiapplyd_build_pdf, aiapplyd_manage_follow_ups, aiapplyd_manage_saved_searches · Destructive: aiapplyd_update_job_preferences, aiapplyd_generate_cover_letter, aiapplyd_manage_saved_searches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
